{% raw %}
`poweroff`: turn the computer off.

## Synopsis

<strong>poweroff</strong>

## Description

<strong>poweroff</strong> ends every process, closing their files (so what they wrote reaches the disks), and turns the computer off, as its power button does. It takes no arguments.

## Exit status

It does not return when it works. If the kernel refuses, the reason is printed and the status is 1.

## Notes

What a process had buffered in its own standard I/O and not yet written is lost, as on Linux; programs should close their files first.

## See also

<strong>reboot</strong>(1), <strong>halt</strong>(1)
